# Lakhdatar Green Energy
> Premium industrial biomass pellet manufacturer based in Tilda, Chhattisgarh, India. High-GCV (3,800–4,200+ kcal/kg) eco-friendly bio-fuel replacing coal in industrial boilers.

## Core Pages
- [Homepage](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/): Company overview, biomass pellet features, and industrial boiler conversion metrics.
- [About Us](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/about.html): Manufacturing process, quality standards, and farmer-sourcing network in Chhattisgarh.
- [Services & Products](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/products&services.html): High-GCV Sawdust Pellets, Mustard Husk Pellets, and Agro-Residue Bio-Pellets.
- [Contact Us](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/contact.html): Bulk purchasing, boiler consulting, and quote requests.
- [Resources Hub](https://lakhdatargreenenergy.com/resources/index.html): Technical guides, ROI calculators, case studies, and FAQs.

## Key Performance Indicators & Specifications
- Gross Calorific Value (GCV): 3,800 – 4,200+ kcal/kg
- Ash Content: < 10%
- Moisture Content: < 10%
- Coal Displacement: Up to 97% reduction in coal dependency
- Scale: 20,000+ metric tonnes delivered across 80+ industrial boiler installations
- Sourcing: 100% farmer-sourced agricultural residue (combating field stubble burning)
